newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB tops turnover on big options volume.
newsitem.headline: NAB tops turnover on big options volume.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) easily topped turnover on the Australian Stock Exchange in early Thursday trade after 26,400 call options were exercised to purchase 26.4 million shares, dealers said.
The options were exercised on the first day's trade ex-NAB's 45 cent dividend.

Brisbane broker Lance Jones said the call options exercised were heavily in the money at various prices. A Sydney broker confirmed the exercising of the 26,400 options, which were processed before the start of trade.
NAB's shares were down 43 cents at A$18.54 by 10.35 a.m. (0035 GMT) on volume of 26.8 million shares traded with a value of over A$432 million.
